DiscordPage.metaDescription: Connect your Discord through Whop to access the RokitG community — Claim Access, not an invite link.

DiscordPage.intro: Your Free Community access lives on Whop, not on a random invite link. Claim your access below and connect Discord from there — that's what actually grants your role in the server.
DiscordPage.warning: Joined through a public invite link instead? That won't give you real access — come back here and claim it through Whop.

DiscordPage.step2Body: Pick the Discord account you want to use in the community.
DiscordPage.step3Body: Whop links your plan to Discord and drops you straight into the server.
